context: Resolve each reference against PubMed through NCBI E-utilities. For a DOI, query ESearch (esearch.fcgi) with db=pubmed, retmode=json, retmax=2, and the term "<doi>"[doi]: exactly one PMID means resolved, zero hits means not found, and two or more hits means ambiguous. For a citation of the form journal|year|volume|first_page|author, submit all distinct citations in one ECitMatch batch (ecitmatch.cgi) with db=pubmed, retmode=xml, rettype=xml, and bdata lines journal|year|volume|first_page|author|token|: a returned PMID means resolved, NOT_FOUND (including INVALID_JOURNAL) means not found, and AMBIGUOUS or several PMIDs means ambiguous. A reference is unresolved exactly when its status is not_found or ambiguous; resolved references are omitted. Output the unresolved references in the original input order, keeping only the first occurrence of duplicates: two DOIs are duplicates when equal case-insensitively; two citations are duplicates when journal, volume, page, and author are equal case-insensitively after collapsing whitespace and the year is equal. Preserve the original kind and value of the kept occurrence.
